deck.en: A few drops on his hand turn into a laugh.
deck.de: Ein paar Tropfen auf der Hand sorgen für Lachen.

intro.ko: 물병 뚜껑이 풀리자 손등에 작은 물방울이 튑니다. 시선은 손으로 내려가고 웃음은 잠깐의 휴식을 길게 만듭니다.
intro.en: The cap comes free and a few drops land on his hand. He looks down at the little splash, and the water break stretches by one more laugh.
intro.de: Der Deckel löst sich und ein paar Tropfen landen auf seiner Hand. Er blickt auf den kleinen Spritzer und verlängert die Trinkpause um ein Lachen.

tip.ko: 물병을 열 때 팔과 어깨가 편하게 움직이는 여유를 두세요.
tip.en: Leave room for the arms and shoulders while opening the bottle.
tip.de: Beim Öffnen der Flasche Platz für Arme und Schultern lassen.

sourceCopy.source: The cap comes free and a few drops land on his hand. He looks down at the little splash and lets the water break last one laugh longer.
